title: Internet-Based Cervical Cytology Screening Program
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to assess whether a system that couples automated screening of Pap Tests with transmission of machine selected digital images, and review by cytologists at a remote location, performs to a clinically effective standard of accuracy.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Female presenting to clinic for a Pap test for any reason

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant
* Prisoners
* Mentally unable to provide informed consent
study_population: Females presenting to clinics at MGH or WRAMC for a Pap test
